pulses.name: FakeWallet crypto stealer spreading in the App Store
pulses.description: In March 2026, over twenty phishing applications were discovered in the Apple App Store masquerading as popular cryptocurrency wallets. These malicious apps redirect users to browser pages distributing trojanized versions of legitimate wallets engineered to steal recovery phrases and private keys. pulses.name: The Gentlemen & SystemBC: A Sneak Peek Behind the Proxy
